features.title: One engine, three kinds of short

drama.title: Drama Stories
drama.description: Character Bible keeps faces consistent across every scene. Five-beat arcs with I2V motion when keyed, Ken Burns otherwise.

news.title: News Shorts
news.description: Paste an article URL. Five editorial beats cover the full story — from headline to outcome — with narrator voiceover and Ken Burns stills.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Explainers
knowledge.description: Type a topic or paste a GitHub README. AI writes the voiceover script, generates editorial stills, and narrates the explainer.

capabilities.title: Built for creators who move fast

items.title: Character Bible
items.description: Lock faces, clothing, and identity. Every scene uses the same passport stills — no jitter between shots.

items.title: Five-Beat Storytelling
items.description: Hook, conflict, rising action, twist, ending. Every short follows a proven dramatic structure.

items.title: AI Voiceover
items.description: ElevenLabs or edge-tts in Vietnamese and English. Word-synced timing drives the entire video clock.

items.title: Karaoke Captions
items.description: Word-level timestamps from TTS or Whisper. Highlighted karaoke ASS subtitles burned into the video.

items.title: Cinematic Motion
items.description: Ken Burns zoompan with cosine ease. Drama scenes can use I2V (Grok, HF, WaveSpeed, Pollinations) when API keys are set.

items.title: Local-First Privacy
items.description: Runs on your machine. No cloud upload required. Your stories and API keys stay local.

items.question: What is omaishort?
items.answer: A local-first video engine that turns stories, news articles, and topics into 1080×1920 short videos with AI voiceover, generated stills, and karaoke captions.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: The engine is free and open source. Some features (ElevenLabs TTS, Grok I2V, Gemini stills) require their own API keys. Basic videos work with zero keys using edge-tts and Pollinations.

items.question: What languages are supported?
items.answer: Video voiceover supports Vietnamese and English with multiple voice options. The UI supports Vietnamese, English, and Japanese.

items.question: Do I need cloud API keys?
items.answer: Not for basic videos. Edge-tts provides free voiceover, and Pollinations generates stills without a key. Add keys for premium providers like ElevenLabs, Gemini, or Grok.

items.question: What video format does it produce?
items.answer: 1080×1920 MP4 at 30fps — the standard vertical short format for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

items.question: Can I use my own images?
items.answer: Yes. Upload face references, location photos, editorial images, or logos through the Studio attachment system. Drama uses face refs for character consistency.

items.question: Does it work offline?
items.answer: The engine runs locally. TTS and image generation need internet unless you run local providers (ComfyUI, Ollama). FFmpeg rendering is fully offline.

cta.subtitle: No cloud account required. Run locally with the CLI, or open the Studio.
